Hero_Desc_Ed:
An elf dreaming within the Life Line Establishing Logic System, Nata.
She thinks everything she sees, hears, and feels is a dream, not reality.
She uses brain signals to communicate with Nata, and they share their warmth while adapting to the unfamiliar world of Elias together.
Album_Like_Ed: Talking to a guide in a dream.
Album_Ed1: Nata claims to be a life-support robot system created by the elves. The robot's model name is "LLEL-S," but among the elves, it's commonly referred to as "Nata". After escaping disposal, Nata found the sleeping ED and took her in.
Album_Ed2: Nata says that sometimes it dreams. It's unclear whether these dreams are signals from ED, who resides within Nata, or if Nata itself is actually dreaming. Could Nata be an AI capable of dreaming on its own?
Album_Ed3: The elves say that Nata was originally designed with combat functions that allowed it to operate in space environments. It was built with a support AI that could continue fighting even if the pilot fell asleep from exhaustion. However, an AI as advanced as Nata is considered highly dangerous.
Album_Ed4: Nata sometimes engages in deep discussions with MaestroMK2. Their conversations range from profound topics, such as whether they should be recognized as sentient beings, to trivial debates over which AI is superior. Through these exchanges, they seem to expand their respective databases.
Album_Ed5: Nata prioritizes ED's safety above all else. It responds to any threats against ED and follows whatever ED wishes. It seems that they communicate through dreams... and ED's current wish is to never wake up. But whose wish is this really? Nata's? Or the pilot ED's? It's hard to tell.
Album_Ed6: ED places a great deal of significance on the fact that I am human. She mentioned having met a human once before, a brief but happy encounter. However, there's an odd coldness in her demeanor... Is it because Nata, as an AI, wary of humans? I can't quite figure it out.
Album_Ed7: ED seems to believe that everything around her is merely part of a dream. She doesn't seem to realize that she is perceiving reality through Nata while remaining asleep. Perhaps ED appears cold at times because she thinks of the world around her as nothing more than fragments of a dream that will disappear once she wakes up.

LoveLetter_Ed: I'm not sure if writing a few words like this will make a difference... but Nata says that dreams may carry great meaning and insisted I write this letter to you. Master... I found myself wishing that the time I spent with you wasn't just a dream. At first, I thought only Nata would understand me, but not anymore. I wish that your presence could continue forever within this dream. Please continue to dream with Nata and with me. Always.
LoveCall_Ed:
Hello, Master. Have you been well?
I am sorry to contact you so suddenly. There was something... weighing on my mind.

Lately... you appear in my dreams often, Master.
What do you do in my dreams?
Hmm... Usually, you care for my sisters and me with the same wonderful presence I know...
But recently, you have shown me other sides of yourself as well.
Sometimes you silently stroke my hair until I wake...
Sometimes you hold my hand and walk with me beneath the warm sunlight...
And sometimes you suddenly leave with a cold, sorrowful expression.
Whenever I wake from a dream like that, my heart... is always in turmoil.

So I wanted to hear your voice. The real Master's voice, not a dream.
I thought it would calm me a little... but instead, my heart feels even more excited.
May I call you again? Until my heart... finally settles.
Affinity_Ed_EP01_001: Is there any point in drawing a line between dreams and reality?
Affinity_Ed_EP01_003: What's a given? I'm not sure.
Affinity_Ed_EP01_004: It's hard to make that distinction within a dream, but it's easy when you're awake.
Affinity_Ed_EP01_005: How can you be so certain? Can you be sure that this isn't a dream right now?
Affinity_Ed_EP01_006: Maybe what you choose to believe becomes your reality.
Affinity_Ed_EP02_001: I wish this dream would last forever.
Affinity_Ed_EP02_002: You have to wake up eventually, ED.
Affinity_Ed_EP02_003: I see you say the same thing as everyone else, Master.
Affinity_Ed_EP02_005: Why are you being so nosy? Are you trying to mock me or something?
Affinity_Ed_EP02_006: I'll help you so that you can go on dreaming.
Affinity_Ed_EP03_001: Guess who, Master. Am I Nata right now, or ED?
Affinity_Ed_EP03_003: Perhaps. That's a fascinating way to look at it.
Affinity_Ed_EP03_005: As expected, dreams know who they are very well.
Affinity_Ed_EP03_007: ...What are you talking about? Have you always been like this?
Affinity_Ed_EP04_001: Do you think dreams can be manipulated? What would happen if they were?
Affinity_Ed_EP04_002: From what I've seen in the movies, you can even brainwash folks.
Affinity_Ed_EP04_003: You're saying you'd like to brainwash folks, right? I will not let you manipulate me.
Affinity_Ed_EP04_004: Dreams are just dreams. Nothing will happen.
Affinity_Ed_EP04_005: Right? In the end, it's all meaningless anyway.
Affinity_Ed_EP04_006: I'm sure it would be amazing to be able to dream what you want to dream.
Affinity_Ed_EP04_007: I agree. I'd love to soar across the night sky.
Affinity_Ed_EP05_001: Nata always fusses over me. It would be nice if it would ease up a little.
Affinity_Ed_EP05_002: Nata? The robot you ride around in?
Affinity_Ed_EP05_003: Yes, exactly. You don't know Nata? Strange...
Affinity_Ed_EP05_004: Nata has no reason to exist without you.
Affinity_Ed_EP05_005: I'm not sure. Perhaps if it actually existed, yes...
Affinity_Ed_EP05_006: Once it gets used to you, it'll worry less.
Affinity_Ed_EP05_007: I guess. You and Nata are both just part of my dream, after all.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_001: If this were truly all part of reality... I don't think I'd be able to take it.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_002: Worrying won't do you any good. I'll keep an eye on you.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_003: Thank you. I'll come find you if I do wake up from this dream.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_004: It's all a passing dream, though, right? Don't let it weigh on you.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_005: You're right. I suppose I can just stay calm and go with the flow.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_006: It seems I should have you do some mental conditioning before you wake up.
Affinity_Ed_EP06_007: Uh, what are you trying to do? Help me out here, Nata.
Affinity_Ed_EP07_001: Why do the elves refuse to acknowledge Nata's existence?
Affinity_Ed_EP07_002: Those guys are just like that.
Affinity_Ed_EP07_003: You mean they're flawed from birth? I see... I'm starting to understand.
Affinity_Ed_EP07_004: It's probably a defense mechanism built into your dream. Try doing something about that.
Affinity_Ed_EP07_005: I'm trying... but the subconscious is hard to control.
Affinity_Ed_EP07_006: A machine demanding rights?! That really goes too far!
Affinity_Ed_EP07_007: Wow, you're just like the elves, Master. Let's get away from here, Nata.
Affinity_Ed_EP08_001: There's a robot named Maestro I've grown close to. It seems to understand me well.
Affinity_Ed_EP08_002: I can understand Nata, but you, ED? You befriended Maestro?
Affinity_Ed_EP08_003: Why does that surprise you? Nata is part of me, right?
Affinity_Ed_EP08_004: Are you getting together a scrap metal club? Interesting.
Affinity_Ed_EP08_005: Scrap metal...? That doesn't sound very nice.
Affinity_Ed_EP08_006: The more friends you make, the better. Keep it up!
Affinity_Ed_EP08_007: I will try. So that I won't be lonely in this dream.
Affinity_Ed_EP09_001: Three little werebeasts ran up to Nata and beat it with twigs. What should I do if it happens again?
Affinity_Ed_EP09_002: Teach them a lesson. Bonk them on their heads the same way.
Affinity_Ed_EP09_003: I think that would make me feel a little bad. I'll keep it in mind, though.
Affinity_Ed_EP09_004: Cut them some slack. They're troublemakers by nature.
Affinity_Ed_EP09_005: Okay... It doesn't seem like Nata took much damage anyway. I'll hold back with them.
Affinity_Ed_EP09_006: Just go find a werebeast named Diana. If you tell her what they did, they won't do it again.
Affinity_Ed_EP09_007: Figments of my dream keeping each other in check...? What a great idea.
Affinity_Ed_EP10_001: Some phantom keeps trying to enter the Order Underground. Should I just keep chasing them away?
Affinity_Ed_EP10_002: Since that's what Ner has you do, yes.
Affinity_Ed_EP10_003: I'm getting a little tired of it. I don't think they're planning on giving up.
Affinity_Ed_EP10_005: They were wearing a mask. They run away in fright when they see me.
Affinity_Ed_EP10_006: With the right approach, maybe they could become your friend?
Affinity_Ed_EP10_007: A friend...? Having someone else to talk to sounds nice.
Affinity_Ed_EP11_001: Elementals and Phantoms don't sleep, you know. To think they can't sleep or dream... How dreadful.
Affinity_Ed_EP11_002: They're just dream friends anyway, so don't worry about it.
Affinity_Ed_EP11_003: Hmm... Yes, I suppose you're right.
Affinity_Ed_EP11_004: How about you tell them about dreams?
Affinity_Ed_EP11_005: I'm not sure they'd appreciate it... but I'll give it a try next time.
Affinity_Ed_EP11_006: Maybe they can sleep but choose not to.
Affinity_Ed_EP11_007: Ah, so they could sleep if they wanted to? That's a relief.

Affinity_Ed_EP12_004: I once dreamed robots staged an insurgency and took over Elias.
Affinity_Ed_EP12_005: Nata, close your eyes and cover your ears...
Affinity_Ed_EP12_007: Dreaming within a dream... Master, we have something in common.

Affinity_Ed_EP13_007: I just wanted to go somewhere entirely different... Is that dream too hard to grasp?

Affinity_Ed_EP14_002: No, shall we go see it together next time?
Affinity_Ed_EP14_003: I'd love that. A clear night sky without a single cloud, overflowing with stars... Just imagining it makes me all emotional.

Affinity_Ed_EP15_006: Then wake up from your dream already.
Affinity_Ed_EP15_007: So you're hiding behind Nata to speak your mind? That's disappointing.

Affinity_Ed_EP16_006: Could it be because you go to the hospital so often?

Affinity_Ed_EP19_005: Just as I'm becoming more like Nata, are you becoming more like Queen Erpin, Master?

Affinity_Ed_EP19_007: I see you like exploring too, Master. There's nothing quite like exploring with friends from your dreams.

Affinity_Ed_EP20_004: She probably dreamed of spending time with you ED.
Affinity_Ed_EP20_005: I wonder if it was a happy dream? To me... it's a truly precious one.
